```{python}
#| output: asis

from pubs_lib import load_entries, format_authors, meta_line

for i, entry in enumerate(load_entries(), start=1):
    if i >= 6:
        break
    title = entry.get("title", "").strip("{}")
    authors = format_authors(entry.get("author", ""), style="initials")
    meta = meta_line(entry)
    print(f"{i}. {authors} ({entry.get('year','')}). {title}. {meta.rsplit(' (', 1)[0]}.")
```
